}}'''Mangore Kiramin''' was the sword-bard of [[Aramaelle]] and [[Warder]] to [[Caraighan Maconar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Mangore Kiramin}}

As well as an accomplished warrior, he also undertook a fragmentary translation of the [[Prophecies of the Dragon]] into what was then called the vulgar tongue; that translation is still quoted and referred to today.
